description: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, Once I Caught a Fish Alive (br19, baby rhymes) models: a soft catch-and-release fishing net, a water bubble and a round arrow icon for LEFT and RIGHT. The fish critter is in animals.json, splash drops in rhymes_br14.json, the counting hands in batch3b.json. Same format as ../models.json. Props face +z.

fishing_net.description: A soft landing net for catch-and-release: a wooden pole 0.9 m tall standing up from its origin (the bottom of the pole, on the ground), a flat hoop rim in the main colour (radius 0.4 m at size 1, its centre at [0, 0.92, 0.38], in front of the pole toward +z) and a see-through white net bag hanging 0.6 m below the rim with three soft rings. A fish of size 0.5 sits in the bag with its origin at about [0, 0.6, 0.38].

bubble.description: A round shiny water bubble 1 m across at size 1 (so size is its width): a see-through ball in the main colour with a white rim glint and two white shines. Floats: the origin is its centre. Rises out of water while counting, and fills HUD tracker slots (size 0.4 in a slot of size 0.56).

arrow_icon.description: A round direction badge 1 m across at size 1, facing +z: a white disc with a coloured rim and a fat arrow in the main colour pointing right (+x). Give it rotation [0, 0, 180] to point left. Floats (origin at its centre); made for the HUD (LEFT and RIGHT) or held up in a scene.
